name: Yagami Kanna
source: One of the three wife candidates and the middle Yagami sister. She is pretty much the embodiment of a perfect wife: intelligent, friendly and kind to everybody. She is also good at domestic chores.
translation: One of the three wife candidates and the middle Yagami sister. She is pretty much the embodiment of a perfect wife: intelligent, friendly and kind to everybody. She is also good at domestic chores.
